# Innovative Financial Services

Innovative Financial Services is a CPA practice in Encino, California.
Owner is Rick Tadros, a Certified Public Accountant with a Master of Science in Taxation.
Work includes tax preparation, tax planning, small business accounting, QuickBooks setup and training, and payroll services.
Clients are individuals, professionals, and small to mid-size businesses.
Office is at 17412 Ventura Blvd. #244, Encino, CA 91316.
Serves Encino and Los Angeles.
Phone is (818) 360-6666. Fax is (818) 357-2260.
Email is Rick@Innovative-CPA.com.
Call or email to set up a free initial consultation.
